## Phase 3 COMP006 Trial Success (February 2026)

On February 17, 2026, Compass Pathways announced the successful achievement of the primary endpoint in the Phase 3 COMP006 trial, the second of two Phase 3 trials evaluating two fixed doses of COMP360 for treatment-resistant depression (TRD).

Two fixed doses of COMP360 25 mg versus 1 mg demonstrated a highly statistically significant reduction in symptom severity with a p-value of <0.001 and a clinically meaningful difference of -3.8 points in change at the primary endpoint.

## Safety Profile

Across both Phase 3 trials, COMP360 is demonstrating a generally well-tolerated and safe profile, with treatment-emergent adverse events being mild or moderate in severity, and the vast majority resolving within 24 hours.

## FDA Path Forward

Compass is advancing discussions with the FDA with the goal of submitting an NDA in Q4 and securing approval. Additionally, the 26-week data (Part B) from COMP006 is expected in early Q3 2026.

Based on the search results, here is a summary of the Phase 3 topline data for Compass Pathways' COMP005 and COMP006 trials:

## COMP005 Results

Compass Pathways reported strongly positive topline results from both pivotal Phase 3 trials of its COMP360 psilocybin treatment for treatment-resistant depression. In COMP005, a single 25 mg dose showed a highly statistically significant mean MADRS improvement versus placebo of -3.6 points at Week 6 (p<0.001), with rapid onset from the day after dosing and durability out to Week 26 for many responders.

## COMP006 Results

In COMP006, two 25 mg doses given three weeks apart achieved a -3.8-point difference versus 1 mg at Week 6 (p<0.001), with 39% of patients reaching a clinically meaningful ≥25% MADRS reduction.

## Safety Profile

I have sufficient verified data to compile the structured block.

---

**CMPS — Compass Pathways plc — Portfolio Research Block (as of 2026-06-21)**

**1. Company / lead asset**
Confirmed: CMPS = Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq ADS). Lead asset is **COMP360**, a proprietary synthetic psilocybin formulation, lead indication **treatment-resistant depression (TRD)**. FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation. (ir.compasspathways.com, biopharmadive.com)

**2. Next known catalyst + timing**
- **COMP006 Part B 26-week durability data** — expected **early Q3 2026** (company guidance; some sources say "2H 2026"). This is the next data event.
- **Final NDA submission — on track for Q4 2026** (rolling submission already underway; sections already filed). Company targets "launch-ready" by end of 2026.
- **Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV)** awarded for COMP360 — potential to compress FDA review to **1–2 months** after final filing. Approval/launch potentially 2027.
(sec.gov 8-K cmps-20260217; biopharmadive.com; moneycheck.com; psychedelicbeacon.com)

**3. What drove the stock over last ~2 weeks (early-to-mid June 2026)**
No single hard CMPS-specific catalyst in the June 8–18 window. Drivers appear to be **continuation of the post-Phase-3 / rolling-NDA re-rating plus psychedelic-sector drift**:
- Sector tailwind from a **Trump executive order fast-tracking psychedelic FDA reviews** and RFK Jr.-driven FDA acceleration (boosted the whole group). (scientificamerican.com; biopharmadive.com "Psychedelics stocks rise")
- **Kathleen Tregoning board appointment** (commercialization/regulatory expertise — Cerevel/Sanofi/Biogen background), read as commercialization-readiness signal. (simplywall.st; yahoo finance)
- **Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference** participation June 3, 2026. (businesswire 20260526)
- Residual momentum from **May analyst upgrades** (Maxim $12→$20 Buy; Morgan Stanley $16→$17) — note: dated May, not June. Consensus PT ~$22–23, Strong Buy. (benzinga; marketbeat; tipranks)
CMPS was ~$12.08 on 2026-06-12, vs your $12.52 on 2026-06-18 close. (stocktitan/marketbeat)

**4. Did the thesis materially improve, or did price just move?**
**Thesis materially improved earlier in 2026, with price catching up since.** Both pivotal Phase 3 trials hit primary endpoints (COMP005 single 25mg: −3.6 MADRS vs placebo, p<0.001; COMP006 two doses: −3.8 vs 1mg, p<0.001), FDA granted rolling NDA review, and CNPV awarded — all genuine de-risking events. The June move is mostly **continuation/sector drift**, not fresh fundamental news in the two-week window.

**5. Financing / dilution / offering flags**
- **$150M public offering priced Feb 19, 2026** (Form 424B5): 17.5M ADS at $8.00 + pre-funded warrants for 1.25M ADS; +30-day option for 2.8M more ADS. Immediate dilution cited at $6.43/ADS. Underwriters Jefferies/TD Cowen/Cantor/Stifel. **This is the most recent equity raise — Feb 2026, NOT a new June event.** (sec.gov 424B5; businesswire 20260218)
- Additionally raised **~$200M from warrant exercises**, extending **cash runway into 2028**. Q1 2026 cash & equivalents ~$466M, debt ~$50.5M. (stocktitan; Q1 2026 results businesswire 20260513)
- Routine 2026 Inducement Plan equity grants June 1, 2026 (157,000 options @ $14.19 + 74,700 RSUs to 17 new hires — immaterial). (businesswire)
- No new June 2026 secondary, ATM, or convertible flagged. **Unverified** whether an ATM program is currently active.

**6. Thesis-intact read**
**Thesis intact — no sign it broke.** Both Phase 3 readouts positive, NDA in rolling submission, CNPV in hand, runway funded into 2028. The one analytical caveat in the data itself: the **efficacy magnitude is modest** (−3.6 / −3.8 MADRS points; ~39% clinically meaningful response in COMP006), which some coverage flagged as raising durability/commercial-traction questions — but it cleared statistical significance. (psychedelicalpha.com "modest magnitude"; medscape)

**7. Main risk next 1–3 months**
- **COMP006 26-week durability data (early Q3 2026)** is binary-ish: weak durability could undercut the commercial story given the already-modest acute effect size. This is the key near-term swing event.
- FDA / NDA execution risk on the rolling submission and CNPV review pathway (novel regulatory path for a psychedelic).
- Sector-sentiment reversal risk: stock is partly riding a psychedelic-sector / executive-order beta that can de-rate quickly.
- Further dilution possible pre-launch (history of equity raises), though runway is funded to 2028.

**8. Sources (URL + date)**
- COMP005/COMP006 topline Phase 3 (COMP006 primary endpoint, Feb 17, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001816590/000181659026000007/cmps-20260217.htm | https://ir.compasspathways.com/News--Events-/news/news-details/2026/Compass-Pathways-Successfully-Achieves-Primary-Endpoint-in-Second-Phase-3-Trial.../default.aspx
- Phase 3 detail / FDA path: https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/compass-trial-data-fda-application-psilocybin-psychedelics/812332/ (Feb 2026)
- Modest-magnitude caveat: https://psychedelicalpha.com/news/breaking-second-positive-phase-3-for-compass-psilocybin-though-modest-magnitude-raises-questions/ (Feb 2026)
- $150M offering pricing (Feb 19, 2026): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260218376418/en/Compass-Pathways-Announces-Pricing-of-$150-Million-Public-Offering | 424B5: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001816590/000162828026009499/cmps-2025prosuppfinal.htm
- Q1 2026 financials / runway to 2028 (May 13, 2026): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260513826535/en/Compass-Pathways-Announces-First-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Business-Highlights
- Rolling NDA + CNPV / 30% pop: https://moneycheck.com/compass-pathways-cmps-stock-soars-30-on-fda-rolling-review-and-priority-voucher/ ; psilocybin tracker (Apr 2026): https://psychedelicbeacon.com/blog/psilocybin-fda-approval-tracker
- Sector / executive order driver: https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/rfk-jr-puts-psychedelics-on-fast-track-to-fda-review-and-approval/ ; https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/psychedelics-stocks-rise-as-compass-psilocybin-drug-heads-to-fda/812441/
- Board appointment (June 2026): https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/pharmaceuticals-biotech/nasdaq-cmps/compass-pathways/news/is-compass-pathways-cmps-recasting-its-commercialization-str
- Jefferies conf June 3, 2026: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260526002111/en/Compass-Pathways-to-Participate-in-Jefferies-Global-Healthcare-Conference-on-June-3-2026
- Analyst PTs (May 2026): https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CMPS/analyst-ratings ; https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CMPS/forecast/

*No buy/sell/hold view expressed — facts only. Items flagged "unverified" where not confirmed.*
